field_principles.field_principles: Each required field states why its evidence is necessary, so an auditor can detect an unjustified inference.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Recorded preconditions distinguish checked absence from a silent fallback.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The substrate declaration prevents an aggregation task from being misrepresented as live model inference.
field_principles.duration_s: Measured wall time makes the amount of work falsifiable.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Content hashes expose source drift between upstream measurement and downstream use.
field_principles.cited_upstream_artifacts: Explicit citations identify the evidence on which this gate depends.
field_principles.upstream_gate_rows: Typed upstream gates preserve each observed pass or failure instead of reducing them to one score.
field_principles.rows: Summary rows make the terminal reduction independently countable.
field_principles.identity_schema_version: A version prevents legacy and current identity meanings from being mixed silently.
field_principles.raw_report_reproduction_rows: Raw-report rows must preserve the server observation before any path resolution.
field_principles.identity_obligation_rows: Typed obligations keep supported, contradicted, and unknown evidence distinct.
field_principles.positive_fixture_rows: Positive fixtures are needed to show that every intended identity branch remains reachable.
field_principles.negative_fixture_rows: Negative fixtures are needed to show that aliases and content substitutions fail closed.
field_principles.unknown_evidence_rows: Unknown rows prove that missing evidence cannot become support by default.
field_principles.legacy_compatibility_rows: Legacy rows require an explicit reader so historical evidence is not rewritten or guessed.
field_principles.producer_wiring_rows: Producer wiring proves that new receipts originate at the shared identity boundary.
field_principles.consumer_wiring_rows: Consumer wiring proves that no evaluation path bypasses the shared validator.
field_principles.requested_model_path: The requested path preserves the selected snapshot name without replacing it with a resolved target.
field_principles.requested_model_filename: The requested filename binds the selected GGUF name independently of the blob name.
field_principles.requested_hf_id: The hub identifier prevents same-named files from another repository from being accepted.
field_principles.requested_revision: The revision binds the model request to one immutable snapshot.
field_principles.launch_model_argument: The launch argument records the exact path passed to the server process.
field_principles.observed_server_model_path: The raw server path is evidence and must remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
field_principles.observed_server_resolved_path: The separately resolved report path allows alias comparison without mutating the raw report.
field_principles.resolved_model_path: The selected model's resolved path identifies the canonical content object.
field_principles.model_file_hash: A content hash rejects same-size files with different bytes.
field_principles.arc_typed_identity_bridge_ready_score: Readiness is one only after every required positive, negative, unknown, legacy, and wiring gate passes.
field_principles.random_seed: A fixed seed makes deterministic fixture construction reproducible.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: A digest of the complete artifact detects any later change.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: The first failed check records its expected and observed values for an actionable blocked verdict.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False states that this provenance verifier does not define ARC game correctness.
field_principles.verdict_class: A closed verdict class prevents a blocked precondition from being read as positive evidence.
field_principles.honest_verdict: A class-consistent terminal prefix lets downstream readers classify this blocked run without guessing.
